lines.1: 「...And that is how I came to be living in this house for a while.」
lines.3: 「I knew you were relatives, but still...」
lines.4: 「The movers should be arriving with my belongings soon.」
lines.8: 「No. I did not intend to ask that much of you. I would feel guilty.」
lines.9: 「You're supposed to be my big sister, right? Why hold back?」
lines.12: 「In that case, we'll head home for now.」
lines.14: 「We'd better take Crab with us. She's unconscious and foaming at the mouth.」
lines.17: 「Hey, the ground turns to dirt past here.」
lines.18: 「I'm not the one getting dirty. What's the problem?」
lines.20: 「Fill Crab in on what happened, okay?」
